description: This file defines classes related to warning reporting categories, specifically for handling plugin state changes and long-running message warnings within the WPEFramework. It includes class definitions for 'TooLongPluginState' and 'TooLongInvokeMessage', with methods for analysis, serialization, deserialization, and string representation.

classes.name: TooLongPluginState
classes.description: Represents the state of a plugin with methods to analyze state changes, serialize/deserialize state data, and generate string descriptions.

classes.name: TooLongInvokeMessage
classes.description: Represents a warning message for long-running invocations, supporting analysis of different message types, serialization/deserialization, and string formatting.

methods.name: Analyze
methods.description: Analyzes input data to set internal state based on message or state change.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the object data into a buffer for storage or transmission.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a buffer to reconstruct the object state.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Generates a human-readable string describing the object's state.
